build_TransformedTargetRegressor: build a RidgeCV regressor with log1p/expm1 target transformation for non-linear regression
create_PredictionErrorDisplay: create actual-vs-predicted and residual-vs-predicted plots for regression model evaluation
run_make_regression: run make_regression to generate a synthetic dataset with configurable noise and sample count
test_RidgeCV: test RidgeCV with and without target transformation to compare R2 and MedAE scores
summarize_compute_score: summarize compute_score that returns R2 and MedAE metrics for regression predictions
